title: Basia Time and Tide CD 1987 - Pop Jazz, Epic Records, VG
descriptionText: The product is a CD titled "Time and Tide" by artist Basia, released in 1987 under the record label Epic Records. The CD is in original 1987 edition format and features a jazz pop style with English language lyrics. Produced by Basia Trzetrzelewska and Danny White, the album was digitally mastered from analog recordings, making it a unique addition to the music collection from the 1980s era. The standard jewel case houses this piece of music history from the United States.
